note: Curated starting points, not market research. NAICS 2022 codes from census.gov/naics. Pain points are hypotheses to test in customer-discovery interviews. SBIR/STTR entries name the participating agencies; check sbir.gov for currently open topics.

industries.name: Infrastructure inspection and monitoring

naics.title: Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing

pain_points: Manual inspection is slow, costly and often needs lane or facility closures.
Owners must show condition data to regulators but have few continuous measurements.

industries.name: Industrial sensing and process control

naics.title: Instruments and Related Products Manufacturing for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables
Other Measuring and Controlling Device Manufacturing

pain_points: Plants need cheaper sensors that can be deployed at scale without downtime.
Raw sensor data is hard to turn into maintenance decisions.

industries.name: Software and applied machine learning

naics.title: Data Processing, Hosting, and Related Services

pain_points: Teams have data but lack models they can validate and trust.
Planning and scheduling is still done by hand in spreadsheets.

industries.name: Cybersecurity and trusted systems
pain_points: Defenders face more alerts than they can triage.

industries.name: Medical devices and diagnostics

naics.title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

pain_points: Diagnosis often needs a lab visit and days of waiting.
Devices must show clinical evidence before hospitals will buy.

industries.name: Biotechnology and drug discovery

naics.title: Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology)

pain_points: Early discovery is expensive and most candidates fail.
Companies license in assets to refill thin pipelines.

industries.name: Energy generation and storage

naics.title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

pain_points: Storage cost and lifetime limit adoption of renewables.
Grid operators need better forecasting and control.

industries.name: Semiconductors, materials and photonics

naics.title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

pain_points: Fabrication yield and cost limit new device designs.
Buyers want drop-in materials that fit existing production lines.

industries.name: Agriculture and environmental technology

naics.title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

pain_points: Producers lack low-cost, timely measurements of field and water conditions.
Regulatory reporting requires data that is expensive to collect.
